canonical_project: Burundi Digital Foundations national physical data hosting solution
owner: Government of Burundi / SETIC / World Bank
notes: World Bank project documentation includes preparation of specifications for a new physical data hosting solution, i.e. a data center, and the Burundi finance ministry's 2026 PAFEN update names a national data center as a priority. Exact site is not public; assigned to Bujumbura Mairie because the program is tied to central government digital infrastructure.
